privacyPolicyContent:
Data Collected:
  • Newsletter: email address
  • Order: name, email address, order content, notes (optional)

Purpose of Data Processing:
  • Sending newsletters, updates on new creations and events
  • Fulfilling and responding to orders
Legal Basis: voluntary consent of the data subject (GDPR Article 6(1)(a))

Data Security: Technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect data. Names and email addresses are stored encrypted and hashed (AES-256-CBC and SHA-256). Order content (details, notes) is stored in plaintext but only forwarded to the data controller's password-protected inbox. Unauthorized persons cannot access the data.
Data Retention: Data is kept until the data subject withdraws consent.
Data Transfer: No data is shared with third parties.

Data Storage: Data is stored on secure servers in password-protected MongoDB databases. Names and emails are encrypted (AES-256) and hashed (SHA-256). Order content is stored in plaintext. Data storage is ensured within the EU (e.g., DigitalOcean EU region).
Withdrawal of Consent: Consent can be withdrawn at any time without justification by contacting the email above.
Cookies and Log Files: The website does not use cookies or collect log or statistical visit data.
Data processing is in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and Council (GDPR).

Rights:
  • Access to your own data
  • Rectification, erasure, restriction of processing
  • Withdrawal of consent
  • Complaint: Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH)

introText:
Origami is the Japanese art of paper folding where any shape can be created from a single sheet of paper without cutting.
It is both a challenge and a meditative activity that improves patience, precision, concentration, and dexterity.
What captivated me most was the act of creation itself. For me, origami is a wonderful journey, an Odyssey.
As the paper slowly comes to life before my eyes, step by step – that’s the most exciting part for me.
Join me in an inspiring demonstration where I present some of my creations and introduce you to the magical world of origami!
